name: Battle Nap
description:
About This Game

Battle Nap is a roguelite top-down shooter where your picnic nap becomes an explosive journey into dreamland domination. Build your arsenal, stack your perks, and blast through your subconscious to ensure you don’t wake up until the job is done.

Don't wake up - the fight is just getting good!

  • God-Tier Perks:
    Perks are your most precious resource. These game-changing abilities are extremely powerful, but you can only carry a few at a time. Choose wisely.

  • A Massive Arsenal 
    Your subconscious is armed to the teeth. From traditional firearms and heavy explosives to experimental energy weapons.

  • Evolve Your Play Style 
    Collect experience from fallen foes to pump up your upgrades, fine-tuning your character to match your specific brand of chaos.

  • Keep the Change
    Even the deepest sleep must end, but your progress doesn't. All the coins you collect are yours to keep, allowing you to buy permanent power-ups to make your next nap even more legendary.

  • Go into Deep Sleep 
    Beating the game is only the beginning. With highly customizable difficulty modifiers, you can push your skills to the limit and see exactly how deep the rabbit hole goes.

  • Infinite Replayability
    No two dreams are the same. With procedural level generation and randomized loot drops, every "nap" offers a fresh challenge and a new path to domination.
